root.label: Bears defeat Titans in 2026 preseason finale

events.label: Bears defeat Titans in 2026 preseason finale

slots.name: preseason games
slots.sentence: The league’s 49-game summer exhibition slate wrapped Saturday, Aug. 29, with the Chicago Bears defeating the Tennessee Titans 24-15 in the final preseason game to be played in Nashville’s Nissan Stadium .
